packet_finding_reviews.rationale: C103 2025-06-30. (a) Retirement: retire_check.py on data/output and nczc PASS (Cohnreznick undrawn line ROW-402e23d5ac7c9aa0 fair_value 0, cost -11,000, as printed '3,477 ( 11 ) - -'); four plants caught; ledger verdict_retired VR-FL-1911066-02, applied_by the investigator under D-252. Sound. (b) The 11 rows: read all 11 printed lines; each is an undrawn 'First Lien Debt (Delayed Draw)' or 'Revolving Loan' with bracketed fair value, cost a dash (PT Intermediate cost 1); published fair values equal the printed figures. C103 excludes rows whose issuer/instrument/identifier text names a revolver or delayed draw (_unfunded_position_sql); the older members carry the company name only, so the text was missing. Setting instrument_description to the printed instrument changes what C103 sees, but towards the page: the values are untouched and the rows are what C103 is designed to pass (sign-consistent unfunded marks). It is a real, page-backed data fix, not a check workaround. Caveats: (1) it is selective: 617 loan rows print 'Revolving' or 'Delayed Draw' and still publish no instrument text, so C103 will misfire again on any future undrawn line of the old member form (see rejected observation instrument-description-not-published-from-page); (2) nczd: VR-FL-1911066-02's reason text is now corrected ('handled by row corrections that publish the printed instrument ... no check repair request was raised'); retire_check.py on nczd PASS, plants caught.

observation_reviews.rationale: Round 3 (restated counts): supported. gapcount.py now joins only current-period page rows (period_role = 'current') with one row per row_id. I re-ran it on nczd: 2,876 loan rows print tranche or lien text and publish no instrument_description, within the 2,885 loan rows that have empty instrument text at all, so there is no double-counting. It finds 612 printed delayed-draw or revolver rows without instrument_type, equal to my contextRef count. The lien-or-tranche-only figure, 2,836, also equals mine. Scope, cause (no step reads the printed instrument cell), parked action and request NCZ-R1 are now consistent and satisfy fix, flag, propose rule given the owner brief against mass row corrections. Earlier round, kept for the record: nczd change-only check of my nczc rejection. Resolved then: the scope now covers 2023-03-31 to 2025-09-30; the cause is stated (no step or wrapper key reads the printed instrument cell); the action is parked with request NCZ-R1. With the owner brief against thousands of row corrections, parked plus a concrete shared-code request satisfies fix, flag, propose rule: a fund agent may not change shared code, and the escalation is specific. Not resolved: the headline counts are wrong. 'In nczd 4,529 loan rows ... publish no instrument_description' cannot be true. nczd has 5,016 loan rows, and only 2,885 have an empty instrument_description of any kind (gap_nczd.sql). gapcount.py joins holdings to bdc_ixbrl_field_status on accession + identifier. Each 10-Q carries current and comparative contexts under the same identifier, so rows fan out; that is also why its join reports '9,070 of 9,107 rows' for a fund with 5,828. The same fan-out probably inflates the 977 instrument_type figure. My contextRef join (one printed line per row, 5,828 of 5,828 mapped) gives 2,836 loan rows that print a lien or tranche word with no instrument_description, and 612 printed delayed-draw or revolver rows with no instrument_type. Fix: deduplicate the join (accession + src_context_id, or take the current-period row only) and restate both counts; then this is supported. The detector proposal is fine.

request_reviews.rationale: Round 3: supported. 'what' now says it is a shared extractor change (new opt-in wrapper key and code), not an acceptance change, labelled acceptance_change only because the contract has two classes and that one routes to the owner. 'why' now says about 2,840 loan rows (2,836 to 2,876 by pattern) and 5,807 of 5,828 rows joined to a printed line, consistent with my counts and the fund's row total. Before implementation it still needs shared-code review, focused and false-positive tests, and a cohort semantic diff. Earlier round, kept for the record: Substance supported: an opt-in wrapper key that fills a blank instrument_description from the tranche cell of the row's own printed line is the right mechanism. It carries forward, unlike 2,800 row corrections, and the false-positive test (company or industry text in the cell) is the right guard. Two defects. (1) Classification: this is not an acceptance change. Nothing in a gate or threshold changes; it is a new shared extractor or staging key, which needs shared-code review and a cohort semantic diff. 'acceptance_change' gets it to the owner, which is the right destination, but it mislabels the request. The contract offers only verification_bug or acceptance_change; record it as acceptance_change with the note 'shared extractor change, not a gate change', or have the owner add a shared_code class. (2) The 'why' tells the owner '4,529 loan rows' and '9,070 of this fund's 9,107 rows'. The fund has 5,828 published rows and 2,885 loan rows with empty instrument text; the figures come from an accession + identifier join that fans out over comparative contexts. Restate as about 2,836 loan rows with printed lien or tranche text (612 delayed-draw or revolver rows without instrument_type) before it goes to the owner. Fix the count and the gap note, and this is supported.
